## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggh4x)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)

if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("microbiome")
library(microbiome)

library(biomformat)
```


```{r}

# 1. Fortæl R at bruge dit rigtige objekt (pylsq), men kalde det 'ps'
ps <- pylsq

sample_data(ps)$Disease.MESH.ID <- factor(
  sample_data(ps)$Disease.MESH.ID, 
  levels = c("D003093", "D006262"), 
  labels = c("Ulcerative Colitis", "Healthy Control")
)

# 2. Transformér til relativ overflod (procent) til brug i graferne
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRIN 1: Det geografiske overblik (PCoA-plot)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ord_bc <- ordinate(ps_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

plot_ordination(ps_rel, ord_bc, color = "Country") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCoA: Er der geografisk forskel på mikrobiomet?",
       subtitle = "Baseret på Bray-Curtis afstand (Genus-niveau)",
       color = "Land")
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRIN 2: Sygdom vs. Sundhed opdelt på lande
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_ordination(ps_rel, ord_bc, color = "Disease.MESH.ID") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Country) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCoA: Sygdomseffekt (Ulcerativ Colitis) opdelt på lande",
       subtitle = "Ser de syges mikrobiom ens ud på tværs af geografi?",
       color = "Status")
```


```{r}
top20_genera <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_rel), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20])
ps_top20 <- prune_taxa(top20_genera, ps_rel)

plot_bar(ps_top20, fill = "Genus") +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color=NA) +  # FJERNER DE SORTE KANTER!
  facet_grid(Disease.MESH.ID ~ Country, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Patienter / Testpersoner", y = "Relativ overflod (Procent)",
       title = "Top 20 dominerende bakterieslægter",
       subtitle = "Opdelt efter land (kolonner) og sygdomsstatus (rækker)")
```

```{r}
ps %>% 
  sample_data() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  count(Country)
```
```{r}
# Lav et søjlediagram over antal testpersoner per land
ps %>% 
  sample_data() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Country, fill = Country)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat='count', aes(label=..count..), vroom = TRUE, vjust = -0.5) + # Sætter tal ovenpå søjlerne
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Land", y = "Antal testpersoner", 
       title = "Fordeling af studiets testpersoner",
       subtitle = "Opdelt på geografisk oprindelse") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") # Skjuler legenden, da landene allerede står på x-aksen
```
```{r}
# Tæl hvor mange raske/syge der er i hvert land
ps %>% 
  sample_data() %>% 
  group_by(Country, Disease.name) %>%
  count(Country, Disease.name)
```
```{r}
ps %>%
  sample_data() %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(count = n())
  
```
